# Xenonids
When the [textlink="Chimera" link="WFLoreChimera"] biomass on [textlink="Aerumna" link="Aerumna"] died back, the surveys expected bare rock. They found fungal forests, glowing slugs and the hives.
Xenonids had been there all along, sealed in resin chambers deep under the biomass, waiting it out. Now they own the surface again.
## The hive
A xenonid hive is one mind spread over many bodies, each grown for its job: drones that build, runners and lurkers that hunt, warriors and ravagers that fight, and a queen that lays the eggs that make more of them. Their resin walls and weeds spread wherever the hive goes.
Wild eggs lie across Aerumna's surface. Anyone who walks too close to one may carry something back to their ship.
## The sector's answer
Nobody has managed to talk to a hive. The navies treat Aerumna as a quarantine world and its hives as something to burn on sight. Researchers would pay well for live samples. The two positions do not get along.
How the hive plays: see the [textlink="xenonid roles" link="RMCGuideXenonidRoles"] in the guidebook.
